coverLetter:
Maya Linden
Portland, OR, USA
maya.linden@example.com
+1 555 0142

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Coinbase

Dear Hiring Manager,

Your Experiential Marketing Associate role comes down to one problem: turning events into polished, on-brand experiences that connect Coinbase with customers, partners and the crypto community. I've worked on the small-scale version of that. At Harbor Street Pet Supply I helped plan a weekend adoption event that brought in about 300 visitors, and I saw how much of an event's success is decided long before the doors open.

I'm early in my career, so I won't pretend to the 2+ years of event experience you list. What I can offer is a record of making audiences show up. As Social Media Lead for the Westbrook Film Society, I raised average screening ticket sales from 35 to 60 per event with a weekly reel. I also grew a newsletter from 640 to 1,150 subscribers. I work in Canva, CapCut, Mailchimp and Excel, and I've completed Google Analytics for Beginners, so I'm comfortable tracking attendance and engagement, the raw material for the post-event reporting you describe. Years of serving up to 150 customers per shift at Corner Bean Cafe taught me to stay calm and deliver when several things happen at once.

I'd like to bring that energy to a remote-first team that pushes past "good enough." I'm available to start soon and would welcome a conversation about how I can support your experiential calendar.

Best regards,
Maya Linden

applicationEmail.subject: Application: Experiential Marketing Associate, Maya Linden
applicationEmail.body:
Dear Coinbase Events Team,

I helped plan a weekend adoption event at Harbor Street Pet Supply that brought in about 300 visitors, and I'd like to build on that kind of hands-on event work in your experiential marketing calendar. I'm a recent communications graduate who also ran a student society's social channels for two years, so I'm used to juggling deadlines and working with different people to get something live. My CV and cover letter are attached for your review. I'm available for a call at any time that suits you, and I can start whenever you need.

Best regards,
Maya Linden
